scope: S22.05 server payload and browser history privacy; read-only retained-evidence audit, no test/native/browser/network execution
conclusion: Existing executed evidence proves pieces; full Back/Forward/BFCache revoked-scope transition remains unverified. No confirmed privacy bug from this review.

executedAssertions.name: invitation secrets leave URL before a request and never enter storage
executedAssertions.actualAssertionScope: Calls consumeInvitation on query+fragment tokens, expects fragment token returned, URL reduced to /invite and localStorage length0. Does not execute navigation or inspect past browser entries.

executedAssertions.name: API is same-origin, no-store, CSRF protected; own projection discards private keys
executedAssertions.actualAssertionScope: Injects budgetMinor/otherAuthors into own-request response and asserts both discarded; command fetch options are same-origin, no-store, CSRF and no Authorization header. Does not seed a private-note marker or inspect browser history.

executedAssertions.name: refresh hides the previous member as soon as the server reports a different or ended session
executedAssertions.actualAssertionScope: Starts with own item; changes session to null or member-b; after app.start and during next recovery callback, prior own item is absent. Does not assert DOM while session request is still pending.

executedAssertions.name: a command refusal hides private content even if the saved outbox cannot be removed
executedAssertions.actualAssertionScope: 401/403 command refusal clears visible private/pending content despite local storage deletion failure; this is response handling, not navigation.

executedAssertions.name: authorized Refresh clears an old mutation access denial without discarding storage warnings
executedAssertions.actualAssertionScope: Queues previous actor request, changes member, explicit Retry refuses any command and hides prior text/form; subsequent authorized Refresh clears stale ordinary denial but preserves cleanup warning.

executedAssertions.name: revocation purges household display and exposes no cached request
executedAssertions.actualAssertionScope: After prior own request visible, explicit Refresh receives requests403; asserts prior item and household label absent and access-ended shown.

executedAssertions.name: a cold reload under a different contributor cannot recover the previous queue
executedAssertions.actualAssertionScope: Fresh WebApp under different member cannot display or retry prior scoped queued request. No actual history traversal.

executedAssertions.name: new sends reauthenticate and cannot publish a private draft as another member
executedAssertions.actualAssertionScope: Changes actor after review; submit issues no command and removes private draft/household display.

executedAssertions.name: revoked queue permission prevents replay even for the same household and member
executedAssertions.actualAssertionScope: After one failed original send, queue permission removed; Retry does not add a command call and removes queued wording.

executedAssertions.name: failed sign-out clears private content and background reload cannot restore it
executedAssertions.actualAssertionScope: Failed logout clears private item/household; app.start while sign-out barrier active makes no additional session read; explicit retry later succeeds.

executedAssertions.name: an interrupted sign-out stays private across a cold reload and retries with the current session
executedAssertions.actualAssertionScope: Constructs new WebApp on same JSDOM window, verifies private text hidden and single localStorage marker, then rotated-CSRF explicit logout clears marker. Not browser BFCache.

executedAssertions.name: expiry during Refresh keeps its current denial after the received-page response finishes
executedAssertions.actualAssertionScope: Helper/editor expiry during deferred received-suggestion refresh must retain access-ended and not repopulate private content. Not contributor navigation.

executedAssertions.name: enrolled child submits only own request and never receives basket, budget, roster or another author request
executedAssertions.actualAssertionScope: Seeds adult and child requests plus3800-cap shop; child mine response exactly one own child item; serialized payload lacks Private adult item/capMinor/unitPrice/budget/guardian/parentEmail; members/shop/inbox/consents routes404. Private-note fixture marker not seeded.

executedAssertions.name: withdrawal retires device/window/invite/claim generation and cannot be undone through HTTP or SQL
executedAssertions.actualAssertionScope: Revokes guardian consent, child bootstrap403, replay window retired and SQL cannot revive enrollment/device. New-server-access authority proof, not old-page lifecycle.

executedAssertions.name: browser helper session stays bound to its selected grant and cannot fall back after revocation
executedAssertions.actualAssertionScope: Creates two grants, browser session stays selected grant, direct other-grant current read404; selected grant revocation makes session403.

executedAssertions.name: only shopper inbox includes author aliases; own requests and receipts remain minimal
executedAssertions.actualAssertionScope: Own send receipt and own requests lack authorAlias while shopper inbox has Sam. Narrow projection assertion, not exhaustive field-list test.

executedAssertions.name: a selected shop excludes another shop’s own request, cursor, command and prior receipt
executedAssertions.actualAssertionScope: Selected-shop headers fence other-shop command/receipt/read/cursor; own list contains only selected-shop item.

Historical service source projection/router/assertion hashes match inspected current files, but no fresh full-service run or transitive deployment acceptance is claimed.
